title: Vanish
description: A single text field on warm white. Type a line and press Enter: the words come apart from left to right, pixel by pixel, each speck of the actual letters lifting up and to the right on a slow curl of air, thinning as it goes, until the field is empty again and the caret and placeholder come back. Keep typing while it happens; the field is never locked.
intent: After Rauno Freiberg's Vanish input (https://rauno.me/craft/vanish-input): submitting a prompt dissolves its own glyph pixels like ink into air and resets the field for the next one, interruptible, real <input>, canvas only for the vanish.
